<script type="text/javascript">
// Tracking variable so that the coreIntcCommunity is only loaded once
let CoreCommunityLoaded = false;

// This variable will hold the standard window.focus method that we override below in order to expose global window properties
const WindowFocus = window.focus;

// TODO: Configuration for the community - see the CoreIntcCommunity documentation for more details
const communityCoreConfig = {};

// This function is called after the coreIntcCommunity script has been loaded
function callCommunityCore() {
  // Call the init method to run code related to your config settings
  window.CoreIntcCommunity.init(communityCoreConfig);
}

// This function is used for getting meta tag values
function getMeta(metaName) {
  const metas = document.getElementsByTagName('META');
  for (let i = 0; i < metas.length; i++) {
    if (metas[i].getAttribute('name') === metaName) {
      return metas[i].getAttribute('content');
    }
  }
  return '';
}

// This function is called after the loadCommunityCore event has been caught by the processEvent method
function insertCoreScript() {
  const scr = document.createElement('script');
  scr.type = 'text/javascript';
  scr.onload = callCommunityCore;
  scr.src = `${$A.get('$Resource.Core_INTC')}/general/coreIntcCommunityMin.js`;
  document.body.appendChild(scr);
}

// Handle window messages fired by the IntelCoreCommunity and CoreIntcCommunity components
function processEvent(evt) {
  const port = (window.location.port ? `:${window.location.port}` : '');
  const fullLocation = `${window.location.protocol}//${window.location.hostname}${port}`;
  if (evt.origin === fullLocation && evt.data) {
    switch (evt.data.type) {
      case 'intel.loadCommunityCore':
        if (!CoreCommunityLoaded) {
          CoreCommunityLoaded = true;
          insertCoreScript();
        }
        break;
      case 'intel.renderBreadcrumbs':
        if (CommunityCoreConfig.ighf.breadcrumbs.available) {
          window.CoreIntcCommunity.renderIghfBreadcrumbs(evt.data.data);
        } else {
          CommunityCoreConfig.ighf.breadcrumbs.waitingData = evt.data.data;
        }
        break;
    }
  }
}

// Sets root level CSS variables
function setCoreCssVariables(config) {
  for (const prop in config) {
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--' + prop, config[prop]);
  }
}

// Allows us to expose global window properties
window.focus = function(dataName, param) {
  if (dataName) {
    let windowData;
    switch (dataName) {
      case 'cookie':
        windowData = document.cookie;
        break;
      case 'meta':
        windowData = {
          pageType: getMeta('pageType') || '',
          title: getMeta('title') || ''
        };
        break;
      case 'setCssVariables':
        if (param) {
            setCoreCssVariables(param);
        }
        break;
      case 'utag':
        windowData = window.utag;
        break;
    }
    return windowData;
  } else {
    // No parameter so run the standard window.focus method
    WindowFocus();
  }
};

// Set up an event listener for when the page has loaded. This is done to manage async behavior and control the availability
// of the Salesforce API.
window.addEventListener('message', processEvent, false);
</script>
